scene_description: A woman wearing a pink top, blue jeans, and yellow rubber gloves is kneeling on a kitchen floor. She is holding a blue and white mop head. Nearby are a red and blue mop bucket, a blue mop handle, and a cleaning cart with supplies. The kitchen has white cabinets and various items on the counter.
